Class Client

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.client.Client
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClientToServerActions
Direct Known Subclasses:
ClientRmi, ClientSocket
public abstract class Client extends Object implements ClientToServerActions
Abstract base class for all client implementations.

Centralizes shared state (matchId, vm, ui) and all game-action validation logic (login(String), createGame(String, int), joinGame(String, int), move(int), draw(int), skip(), requestRanking()), eliminating duplication between ClientRmi and ClientSocket.

Subclasses implement only the transport layer via the protected doXxx Template Method hooks: doLogin(String), doCreateGame(String, int), doJoinGame(String, int), doMove(int), doDraw(int), doSkip(), doRequestRanking().

    • move

      public void move(int tileId)
      Validates the move action against the current game state, then delegates to doMove(int). Shows an error if the client is not in a match, the current phase is not GamePhaseEnum.SETUP_PHASE, it is not the player's turn, the tile index is out of bounds, or the target tile is already occupied.
      Specified by:
      move in interface ClientToServerActions
      Parameters:
      tileId - the 0-based index of the target tile

    • draw

      public void draw(int card)
      Validates the draw action against the current game state, then delegates to doDraw(int). Shows an error if the client is not in a match, the current phase is not a draw phase, it is not the player's turn, the card is not in either draw list, no draws remain from the appropriate list, or the player cannot afford a building card.
      Specified by:
      draw in interface ClientToServerActions
      Parameters:
      card - the unique identifier of the card to draw

    • skip

      public void skip()
      Validates the skip action against the current game state, then delegates to doSkip(). Shows an error if the client is not in a match, the current phase is not a draw phase, it is not the player's turn, or the skip action is not currently allowed.
      Specified by:
      skip in interface ClientToServerActions
